inventory.gap_count_method: Count all entries in `.records[].gaps[]` from a fresh `npm run --silent data:gaps` report.
inventory.selection_note: Next ten evidence-found fields after excluding B119/B120 targets and adjacent recently audited fields that remained open.

scope.research_boundary: Inspect only the frozen records, attempts and their accepted sources first, one exact model/source at a time. Check one current primary exact-model source only where needed to resolve an existing uncertainty. Record source URL and access date; preserve generation, market, option, size, measurement and methodology limits. Evidence-only Luna Max review; primary writer integrates any supported result.
excluded: No fields outside the ten frozen targets.
Do not repeat recent B119/B120 audits or reopen recently audited unresolved fields without new source evidence.
Do not transfer claims across model generations, build options or adjacent TWITTER models.
No new image records, third-party image hosting, or rights assumptions.
